svg.data-latency: less than 500 ns port to port (cut-through)
svg.data-psus: 2 x 550 W AC hot-swap CRPS, 1+1 redundant
svg.data-input-dc: 180-300 VDC auto input (datasheet; no DC SKU is listed)
svg.data-cpu: Intel Denverton x86 (up to 8-core), 8-32 GB ECC DDR4, configurable M.2 SSD
svg.data-bmc: DDR3 1-4 Gb, SPI flash 8-64 Mb dual boot, NC-SI shared management port, IPMI 2.0, SOL
svg.data-onie: ONIE installer for third-party network operating systems
svg.data-optics-sfp28: datasheet 'Transceivers: SFP28 upto 2W'; guide Table 6 lists 10GBASE SR/LR optics and copper DAC 1 m 30 AWG, 3 m 28 AWG, 5 m 26 AWG.
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: datasheet 'QSFP28 upto 5.5W power, DAC (to 5m passive)'; guide Table 6: 100GBASE-SR4 over OM3/OM4, 100GBASE-LR4 (10 km), 100GBASE-CR4 1/3/5 m, and 4 x 25G breakout by cable without a reboot.
svg.data-timing: IEEE 1588 1-step and 2-step, TC and BC mode, SyncE recovery (option)
svg.data-routing-tables: up to 48K MPLS labels, up to 324K L3 LPM, up to 18K ACLs
svg.data-mgmt-ports: rear: 1 x RJ45 CPU/BMC shared Ethernet management (10/100/1000), 1 x RJ45 serial console (9600-115200 8N1), 1 x USB 2.0 Type A host (data only)
svg.data-emc: CN (GB9254-2008), EU (EN55022, EN55024), FCC, VCCI, CCC

g.data-description: the two lug tags, the USB glyph and the rear screws
g.title: lug-tag
